This article analyzes the national-level fulfillment of eight clinical quality indicators for inflammatory bowel disease care, as detailed in the 2024 annual report [^src1]. The comparison evaluates performance across these indicators against established development targets, while also providing a year-over-year comparison with 2023 results for select measures [^src1].

In the 2024 reporting period, [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] (fecal calprotectin measurement) and [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]] (PSC follow-up) emerged as the leaders, being the only indicators to meet or exceed the ≥ 80% fulfillment target, scoring 83% and 81% respectively [^src1]. [[indikator-1a|Indikator 1a]] (diagnostic workup for newly diagnosed adults) narrowly missed the lead, achieving 79% [^src1]. Conversely, the trailers include [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] (DEXA scanning for steroid treatment) at 37% and [[indikator-1b|Indikator 1b]] (diagnostic workup for children and youth) at 69%, both falling significantly short of the ≥ 80% goal [^src1]. [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]] (education for newly diagnosed) recorded the lowest overall fulfillment at 13%, though it has no assigned target [^src1].

Out of the indicators with defined thresholds, only Indikator 5 and Indikator 7 successfully met their ≥ 80% targets in 2024 [^src1]. The remaining indicators with minimum thresholds—Indikator 1a (79%), Indikator 1b (69%), [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] (65%), and Indikator 4 (37%)—all missed the ≥ 80% mark [^src1]. [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] (re-operation) missed its maximum threshold target of ≤ 8%, recording a rate of 13% [^src1].

Because the data is drawn from a single consolidated table section, broad multi-year trends across multiple dated sections cannot be established, but specific year-over-year changes between 2023 and 2024 are evident for the indicators that report both years [^src1]. Indikator 5 showed notable improvement, rising from 79% in 2023 to 83% in 2024, thereby crossing the threshold to meet its target [^src1]. Indikator 7 experienced a slight decline from 85% in 2023 to 81% in 2024, but remained above the target [^src1]. Conversely, Indikator 6 worsened, with the re-operation rate increasing from 11% in 2023 to 13% in 2024, moving further away from the desired ≤ 8% maximum [^src1].

Furthermore, Indikator 6 stands out as a structural outlier: it is the only indicator where a higher percentage represents a negative outcome, and its target is framed as a maximum limit (≤ 8%) rather than a minimum fulfillment goal (≥ 80%) [^src1]. Additionally, Indikator 2 is an outlier as the only measured indicator lacking a defined development target [^src1].

| Indikator 1b: Udredning, nydiagnosticerede børn og unge | 01.10.2022 - 30.09.2023 | 69 (62-75) | | ≥ 80 | | |
| Indikator 2: Undervisning, nydiagnosticerede | 01.10.2022 - 30.09.2023 | 13 (11-14) | | | | |
| Indikator 3: Post-operativ Crohns, opfølgning | 01.10.2022 - 30.09.2023 | 65 (58-72) | | ≥ 80 | | |
| Indikator 4: DEXA-scanning, steroidbehandling | 01.10.2022 - 30.09.2023 | 37 (34-40) | | ≥ 80 | | |
| Indikator 5: Fæces calprotectin måling, BMSL | 01.10.2023 - 30.09.2024 | 83 (82-84) | 79 | ≥ 80 | | |
| Indikator 6: Re-operation | 01.10.2023 - 30.09.2024 | 13 (10-15) | 11 | ≤ 8 | | |
| Indikator 7: PSC, opfølgning | 01.10.2023 - 30.09.2024 | 81 (77-85) | 85 | ≥ 80 | | |

Entities: indikator-1a, indikator-1b, indikator-2, indikator-3, indikator-4, indikator-5, indikator-6, indikator-7

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner opfyldelsen af otte kvalitetsindikatorer på landsplan mellem 2023 og 2024, og viser at kun Indikator 5 og 7 opfylder udviklingsmålet på ≥ 80 % i 2024, mens Indikator 6 overskrider sit maksimumsmål på ≤ 8 %.
